text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I wonder when it started. I began pulling 
my hat down low, so very low—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Because I want to hide my pathetic self...

text_block_list.name: Young Sisters
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas, ma'am! Merry Christmas, 
ma'am!♡

text_block_list.name: Female Guest
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Verxina and Vivlos! Thank you for the 
lovely welcome. Merry Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad to see you again this year. 
Please, make yourself at home and enjoy 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Young Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Papa and Mama said they'd come by to say 
hello later!

text_block_list.name: Female Guest
text_block_list.text:
My, my, aren't you two amazing! Every time 
I see you, you're growing so dependable—

text_block_list.name: Young Cheval
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, excuse me... Ma'am...! I-I'd also 
like to...!"

text_block_list.name: Female Guest
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you for welcoming me too, 
Cheval Grand. Merry Christmas♪

text_block_list.name: Young Cheval
text_block_list.text: Merry... Christmas...

text_block_list.name: Young Cheval
text_block_list.text:
(With a quiet voice like this, there's no 
way they heard me... Even after practicing 
so much... why am I like this...?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"If I can't do it anyway, I'd rather just 
hide. I'm sure no one cares about me 
anyway."

text_block_list.name: Close Friend Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Crown-san! I heard your debut is set! 
Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Aha, hou do ze nei! Of course I plan to 
give it my all. Especially with such 
formidable rivals around—

text_block_list.name: Close Friend Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...I see, Duramente-san is in your 
generation... She comes from an incredible 
pedigree of athletes, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Close Friend Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
She's strong, but... I heard she's a bit 
scary. Like she's always training quietly 
all by herself...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't go so far as to say she's 
scary... —Actually, we're dorm roommates, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
She's stoic and has talent worthy of 
respect. All the more reason I can't lose 
to a fellow classmate!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Both you and I are on medium-to-long 
distance routes, Kura-chan, so our 
schedules are bound to clash with 
Duramente-san's.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“Still, seeing them as rivals already is 
amazing, Cla-chan. It's like you're 
looking so far ahead...”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Now that my debut is set, as their 
classmate, I gotta work hard not to lose 
to those two!

text_block_list.name: Close Friend Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! With Kita-chan's pure grit, 
you're bound to get great results!

text_block_list.name: Close Friend Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Miss Crown, Kita-chan, I'll be cheering 
for you both at your debut races, so do 
your best!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Kita-san and the others are debuting 
too... Those three are my generation...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(It's fine if she doesn't notice me. After 
all, she's so radiant, I could never get 
close anyway...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I thought that if I just kept running, 
maybe someone like me would eventually be 
acknowledged...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Still, there are so many girls at the 
academy who are stronger, more talented, 
and shining brighter than me...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Why am I... always like this...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, full-scale training 
towards the Make Debut with Cheval Grand 
begins.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, pushing too hard on the first day 
wouldn't be good. The plan today is just 
to breeze through basic practice and wrap 
up, but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —H-Aaaagh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps nervous because it's the first 
day, Cheval Grand's movements are stiff.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, one more lap, right? ...H-Here I 
go!"
choice_data_list: Wait, let me catch my breath first—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She left before I could stop her. That 
earnestness and sheer dedication are 
definitely among her greatest strengths.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, I want to build a solid 
bond of trust and guide that earnest 
devotion in the right direction.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —Haa... haa...
choice_data_list: Shall we stop around here for today?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh... Already? ....... I-I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I... wasn't able to move very well... 
Could it be... was it fast because of 
that...?
choice_data_list:
No, no! That was the plan from the very 
start!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Letting fatigue linger from day one won't 
do us any good later. When I told her that 
her movements were plenty good, her 
expression finally softened a bit.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I see... What a relief...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um, Trainer-san. I know I'm nothing 
special..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Still, there's a dream I want to make 
come true no matter what... That's why I, 
well... um...—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She fumbles for words. Another of her 
defining traits is a profound lack of 
self-confidence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has talent. She has dedication. So why 
does she lack confidence to this 
extent...? Just then—

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Oh, looks like it's starting!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Drawn by the voices, I look over to see 
two girls who seem about to run together 
drawing quite a crowd.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Are you really going to run? I won't be 
able to match your pace, you know?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It's fine! I just really want to run with 
you, Sis! I'll do my best not to fall 
behind! Okay?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Drawing all eyes with her queenly presence 
is Verxina, who secured her first GⅠ 
victory in last year's Victoria Mile. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Acting spoiled beside her is her younger 
sister, Verxina's sister Vilblos. Though 
she still has a slender frame before her 
debut, they say her speed shows brilliant 
promise."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, when all is said and done, these 
two are—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, as expected of big sis! But still, I 
won't lose either...――

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Verxina-san is so fast! GI Umamusume 
really are incredible, huh!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Her performance at last year's Victoria 
Mile was eye-poppingly strong! I'm sure 
she'll be a regular contender in graded 
races from now on, won't she?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Did you see her little sister's final 
burst of speed...? Guess that talent runs 
in the family. I'm sure they'll both do 
amazing together—wait."

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Was that her only younger sister? I'm 
pretty sure Verxina-san has another one—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, Verxina and Vivlos are sisters. And 
sandwiched between those two glamorous 
girls is Cheval Grand right here. 
However—"

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you imagining things? If there was 
another sister that flashy, you'd 
definitely remember her.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ……! Trainer, um…… I……!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......I'm terribly sorry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I hurriedly chased after her, Cheval 
Grand was standing behind the empty school 
building, her shoulders slumped in 
dejection.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I... I'm so sorry, I... Running away like 
that... it's so pathetic of me, isn't 
it...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Still...—it's, it's just so pathetic...! 
When Big Sis and Vivlos are both so 
incredible.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...It's always been like that. Those two 
are dazzling and talented. Everyone 
expects so much from them... and yet."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —I'm different.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm the only pathetic one. Even though 
we're sisters, I'm the only plain and 
inferior one... Nobody praises my running, 
either...

text_block_list.name: Club Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Still, those sisters over there sure are 
talented!

text_block_list.name: Club Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Verxina shows so much promise for the 
future! And Vivlos has a real spark in her 
too!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I know. That I should... give up on 
running...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm not as skilled as Big sis... Nor do I 
have the promising talent like my little 
sister...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: But... my dream...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Because... I found my dream...—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-I am, I am—I am...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I want to become... the number one, most 
greatest Umamusume in the world...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It's surely... way too big for me... And 
yet, you nodded and agreed, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That's why......... I don't want to give 
up...! Even though I ran away just now and 
looked so pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Even someone like me... someday, could 
make everyone unable to take their eyes 
off...—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Because... I want to become a "great 
Umamusume"...!
choice_data_list:
You can do it. You're a talented 
Umamusume, after all.

You can do it. You are a talented 
Umamusume, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand, who lacks an astounding 
amount of self-confidence, desperately 
squeezed out her own wish. I once again 
feel determined to reward her bravery.
choice_data_list:
So let's make your dream come true 
together.

So let's make your dream come true 
together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you're feeling anxious, I'll tell you 
as many times as it takes. That you'll be 
fine. That you're amazing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you're feeling anxious, I'll tell you 
as many times as it takes. That you'll be 
fine. That you're amazing.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
“......I'm so sorry. Right on our very 
first day of training... to have this 
happen...”

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
B-B-But, um... I-I'll... really do my 
best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To an apologetic Cheval Grand, I gave a 
firm nod to reassure her that it was 
alright.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Until the day she can stand tall and say, 
"I am magnificent!"... I resolved to 
support her with everything I had.
